ar: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ قٓ وَٱلْقُرْءَانِ ٱلْمَجِيدِ
en: (1) Qāf.[1524] By the honored Qur’ān...[1525]
enNotes:
[1524]- See footnote to 2:1.
[1525]- See footnote to 38:1.
tr: Qāf, wal-qurʾānil-majīd

ar: بَلْ عَجِبُوٓا۟ أَن جَآءَهُم مُّنذِرٌ مِّنْهُمْ فَقَالَ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ هَٰذَا شَىْءٌ عَجِيبٌ
en: (2) But they wonder that there has come to them a warner from among themselves, and the disbelievers say, "This is an amazing thing.
tr: Bal ʿajibū an jāʾahum mundhirum minhum faqālal-kāfirūna hādhā shayʾun ʿajīb

ar: أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا ذَٰلِكَ رَجْعٌۢ بَعِيدٌ
en: (3) When we have died and have become dust, [we will return to life]? That is a distant [i.e., unlikely] return."
tr: Aʾidhā mitnā wakunnā turābā, dhālika rajʿum baʿīd

ar: قَدْ عَلِمْنَا مَا تَنقُصُ ٱلْأَرْضُ مِنْهُمْ وَعِندَنَا كِتَٰبٌ حَفِيظٌۢ
en: (4) We know what the earth diminishes [i.e., consumes] of them, and with Us is a retaining record.
tr: Qad ʿalimnā mā tanquṣul-arḍu minhum, waʿindanā kitābun ḥafīẓ

ar: بَلْ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِٱلْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَآءَهُمْ فَهُمْ فِىٓ أَمْرٍ مَّرِيجٍ
en: (5) But they denied the truth when it came to them, so they are in a confused condition.
tr: Bal kadhdhabū bil-ḥaqqi lammā jāʾahum fahum fī amrim marīj

ar: أَفَلَمْ يَنظُرُوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَوْقَهُمْ كَيْفَ بَنَيْنَٰهَا وَزَيَّنَّٰهَا وَمَا لَهَا مِن فُرُوجٍ
en: (6) Have they not looked at the heaven above them - how We structured it and adorned it and [how] it has no rifts?
tr: Afalam yanẓurū ilas-samāʾi fawqahum kayfa banaynāhā wazayyannāhā wamā lahā min furūj

ar: وَٱلْأَرْضَ مَدَدْنَٰهَا وَأَلْقَيْنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِىَ وَأَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ زَوْجٍۭ بَهِيجٍ
en: (7) And the earth - We spread it out and cast therein firmly set mountains and made grow therein [something] of every beautiful kind,
tr: Wal-arḍa madadnāhā waʾalqaynā fīhā rawāsiya waʾambatnā fīhā min kulli zawjim bahīj

ar: تَبْصِرَةً وَذِكْرَىٰ لِكُلِّ عَبْدٍ مُّنِيبٍ
en: (8) Giving insight and a reminder for every servant who turns [to Allāh].
tr: Tabṣirataw wadhikrā likulli ʿabdim munīb

ar: وَنَزَّلْنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً مُّبَٰرَكًا فَأَنۢبَتْنَا بِهِۦ جَنَّٰتٍ وَحَبَّ ٱلْحَصِيدِ
en: (9) And We have sent down blessed rain from the sky and made grow thereby gardens and grain from the harvest
tr: Wanazzalnā minas-samāʾi māʾam mubārakan faʾambatnā bihī jannātiw waḥabbal-ḥaṣīd

ar: وَٱلنَّخْلَ بَاسِقَٰتٍ لَّهَا طَلْعٌ نَّضِيدٌ
en: (10) And lofty palm trees having fruit arranged in layers -
tr: Wan-nakhla bāsiqātil lahā ṭalʿun naḍīd

ar: رِّزْقًا لِّلْعِبَادِ وَأَحْيَيْنَا بِهِۦ بَلْدَةً مَّيْتًا كَذَٰلِكَ ٱلْخُرُوجُ
en: (11) As provision for the servants, and We have given life thereby to a dead land. Thus is the emergence [i.e., resurrection].
tr: Rizqal lil-ʿibādi waʾaḥyaynā bihī baldatam maytā, kadhālikal-khurūj

ar: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ وَأَصْحَٰبُ ٱلرَّسِّ وَثَمُودُ
en: (12) The people of Noah denied before them,[1526] and the companions of the well[1527] and Thamūd
enNotes:
[1526]- i.e., before the disbelievers of Makkah.
[1527]- See footnote to 25:38.
tr: Kadhdhabat qablahum qawmu nūḥiw waʾaṣḥābur-rassi wathamūd

ar: وَعَادٌ وَفِرْعَوْنُ وَإِخْوَٰنُ لُوطٍ
en: (13) And ʿAad and Pharaoh and the brothers [i.e., people] of Lot
tr: Waʿāduw wafirʿawnu waʾikhwānu lūṭ

ar: وَأَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْأَيْكَةِ وَقَوْمُ تُبَّعٍ كُلٌّ كَذَّبَ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ وَعِيدِ
en: (14) And the companions of the thicket and the people of Tubbaʿ. All denied the messengers, so My threat was justly fulfilled.
tr: Waʾaṣḥābul-aykati waqawmu tubbaʿ, kullun kadhdhabar-rusula faḥaqqa waʿīd

ar: أَفَعَيِينَا بِٱلْخَلْقِ ٱلْأَوَّلِ بَلْ هُمْ فِى لَبْسٍ مِّنْ خَلْقٍ جَدِيدٍ
en: (15) Did We fail in the first creation? But they are in confusion over a new creation.
tr: Afaʿayīnā bil-khalqil-awwal, bal hum fī labsim min khalqin jadīd

ar: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ وَنَعْلَمُ مَا تُوَسْوِسُ بِهِۦ نَفْسُهُۥ وَنَحْنُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ حَبْلِ ٱلْوَرِيدِ
en: (16) And We have already created man and know what his soul whispers to him, and We are closer[1528] to him than [his] jugular vein.
enNotes: [1528]- In absolute knowledge of everything about him. "We" has also been interpreted to mean the angels who are mentioned in the following verse.
tr: Walaqad khalaqnal-insāna wanaʿlamu mā tuwaswisu bihī nafsuh, wanaḥnu aqrabu ilayhi min ḥablil-warīd

ar: إِذْ يَتَلَقَّى ٱلْمُتَلَقِّيَانِ عَنِ ٱلْيَمِينِ وَعَنِ ٱلشِّمَالِ قَعِيدٌ
en: (17) When the two receivers [i.e., recording angels] receive,[1529] seated on the right and on the left.
enNotes: [1529]- And record each word and deed.
tr: Idh yatalaqqal-mutalaqqiyāni ʿanil-yamīni waʿanish-shimāli qaʿīd

ar: مَّا يَلْفِظُ مِن قَوْلٍ إِلَّا لَدَيْهِ رَقِيبٌ عَتِيدٌ
en: (18) He [i.e., man] utters no word except that with him is an observer prepared [to record].
tr: Mā yalfiẓu min qawlin illā ladayhi raqībun ʿatīd

ar: وَجَآءَتْ سَكْرَةُ ٱلْمَوْتِ بِٱلْحَقِّ ذَٰلِكَ مَا كُنتَ مِنْهُ تَحِيدُ
en: (19) And the intoxication of death will bring the truth; that is what you were trying to avoid.
tr: Wajāʾat sakratul-mawti bil-ḥaqq, dhālika mā kunta minhu taḥīd

ar: وَنُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلْوَعِيدِ
en: (20) And the Horn will be blown. That is the Day of [carrying out] the threat.
tr: Wanufikha fiṣ-ṣūr, dhālika yawmul-waʿīd

ar: وَجَآءَتْ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ مَّعَهَا سَآئِقٌ وَشَهِيدٌ
en: (21) And every soul will come, with it a driver and a witness.[1530]
enNotes: [1530]- i.e., one angel driving the soul to the Judgement and one to testify as to its deeds.
tr: Wajāʾat kullu nafsim maʿahā sāʾiquw washahīd

ar: لَّقَدْ كُنتَ فِى غَفْلَةٍ مِّنْ هَٰذَا فَكَشَفْنَا عَنكَ غِطَآءَكَ فَبَصَرُكَ ٱلْيَوْمَ حَدِيدٌ
en: (22) [It will be said], "You were certainly in unmindfulness of this, and We have removed from you your cover,[1531] so your sight, this Day, is sharp."
enNotes: [1531]- Of heedlessness, or that which had sealed your hearing, your vision and your heart from guidance.
tr: Laqad kunta fī ghaflatim min hādhā fakashafnā ʿanka ghiṭāʾaka fabaṣarukal-yawma ḥadīd

ar: وَقَالَ قَرِينُهُۥ هَٰذَا مَا لَدَىَّ عَتِيدٌ
en: (23) And his companion, [the angel], will say, "This [record] is what is with me, prepared."
tr: Waqāla qarīnuhū hādhā mā ladayya ʿatīd

ar: أَلْقِيَا فِى جَهَنَّمَ كُلَّ كَفَّارٍ عَنِيدٍ
en: (24) [Allāh will say], "Throw into Hell every obstinate disbeliever,
tr: Al-qiyā fī jahannama kulla kaffārin ʿanīd

ar: مَّنَّاعٍ لِّلْخَيْرِ مُعْتَدٍ مُّرِيبٍ
en: (25) Preventer of good, aggressor, and doubter,
tr: Mannāʿil lil-khayri muʿtadim murīb

ar: ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَأَلْقِيَاهُ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلشَّدِيدِ
en: (26) Who made [as equal] with Allāh another deity; then throw him into the severe punishment."
tr: Al-ladhī jaʿala maʿallāhi ilāhan ākhara faʾalqiyāhu fil-ʿadhābish-shadīd

ar: قَالَ قَرِينُهُۥ رَبَّنَا مَآ أَطْغَيْتُهُۥ وَلَٰكِن كَانَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍۭ بَعِيدٍ
en: (27) His [devil] companion will say, "Our Lord, I did not make him transgress, but he [himself] was in extreme error."
tr: Qāla qarīnuhū rabbanā mā aṭghaytuhū walākin kāna fī ḍalālim baʿīd

ar: قَالَ لَا تَخْتَصِمُوا۟ لَدَىَّ وَقَدْ قَدَّمْتُ إِلَيْكُم بِٱلْوَعِيدِ
en: (28) [Allāh] will say, "Do not dispute before Me, while I had already presented to you the threat [i.e., warning].
tr: Qāla lā takhtaṣimū ladayya waqad qaddamtu ilaykum bil-waʿīd

ar: مَا يُبَدَّلُ ٱلْقَوْلُ لَدَىَّ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ بِظَلَّٰمٍ لِّلْعَبِيدِ
en: (29) The word [i.e., decree] will not be changed with Me, and never will I be unjust to the servants."
tr: Mā yubaddalul-qawlu ladayya wamā ana biẓallāmil lil-ʿabīd

ar: يَوْمَ نَقُولُ لِجَهَنَّمَ هَلِ ٱمْتَلَأْتِ وَتَقُولُ هَلْ مِن مَّزِيدٍ
en: (30) On the Day We will say to Hell, "Have you been filled?" and it will say, "Are there some more,"
tr: Yawma naqūlu lijahannama halimtalaʾti wataqūlu hal mim mazīd

ar: وَأُزْلِفَتِ ٱلْجَنَّةُ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ غَيْرَ بَعِيدٍ
en: (31) And Paradise will be brought near to the righteous, not far,
tr: Waʾuzlifatil-jannatu lil-muttaqīna ghayra baʿīd

ar: هَٰذَا مَا تُوعَدُونَ لِكُلِّ أَوَّابٍ حَفِيظٍ
en: (32) [It will be said], "This is what you were promised - for every returner [to Allāh] and keeper [of His covenant].
tr: Hādhā mā tūʿadūna likulli awwābin ḥafīẓ

ar: مَّنْ خَشِىَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنَ بِٱلْغَيْبِ وَجَآءَ بِقَلْبٍ مُّنِيبٍ
en: (33) Who feared the Most Merciful in the unseen and came with a heart returning [in repentance].
tr: Man khashiyar-raḥmāna bil-ghaybi wajāʾa biqalbim munīb

ar: ٱدْخُلُوهَا بِسَلَٰمٍ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلْخُلُودِ
en: (34) Enter it in peace. This is the Day of Eternity."
tr: Udkhulūhā bisalām, dhālika yawmul-khulūd

ar: لَهُم مَّا يَشَآءُونَ فِيهَا وَلَدَيْنَا مَزِيدٌ
en: (35) They will have whatever they wish therein, and with Us is more.
tr: Lahum mā yashāʾūna fīhā waladaynā mazīd

ar: وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْنٍ هُمْ أَشَدُّ مِنْهُم بَطْشًا فَنَقَّبُوا۟ فِى ٱلْبِلَٰدِ هَلْ مِن مَّحِيصٍ
en: (36) And how many a generation before them did We destroy who were greater than them in [striking] power and had explored throughout the lands. Is there any place of escape?
tr: Wakam ahlaknā qablahum min qarnin hum ashaddu minhum baṭshan fanaqqabū fil-bilād, hal mim maḥīṣ

ar: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَذِكْرَىٰ لِمَن كَانَ لَهُۥ قَلْبٌ أَوْ أَلْقَى ٱلسَّمْعَ وَهُوَ شَهِيدٌ
en: (37) Indeed in that is a reminder for whoever has a heart or who listens while he is present [in mind].
tr: Inna fī dhālika ladhikrā liman kāna lahū qalbun aw alqas-samʿa wahuwa shahīd

ar: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فِى سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ وَمَا مَسَّنَا مِن لُّغُوبٍ
en: (38) And We did certainly create the heavens and earth and what is between them in six days, and there touched Us no weariness.
tr: Walaqad khalaqnas-samāwāti wal-arḍa wamā baynahumā fī sittati ayyām, wamā massanā mil lughūb

ar: فَٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ ٱلشَّمْسِ وَقَبْلَ ٱلْغُرُوبِ
en: (39) So be patient, [O Muḥammad], over what they say and exalt [Allāh] with praise of your Lord before the rising of the sun and before its setting,
tr: Faṣbir ʿalā mā yaqūlūna wasabbiḥ biḥamdi rabbika qabla ṭulūʿish-shamsi waqablal-ghurūb

ar: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَأَدْبَٰرَ ٱلسُّجُودِ
en: (40) And [in part] of the night exalt Him and after prostration [i.e., prayer].
tr: Waminal-layli fasabbiḥhu waʾadbāras-sujūd

ar: وَٱسْتَمِعْ يَوْمَ يُنَادِ ٱلْمُنَادِ مِن مَّكَانٍ قَرِيبٍ
en: (41) And listen on the Day when the Caller[1532] will call out from a place that is near -
enNotes: [1532]- An angel who will call out Allāh's command for the Resurrection.
tr: Wastamiʿ yawma yunādil-munādi mim makānin qarīb

ar: يَوْمَ يَسْمَعُونَ ٱلصَّيْحَةَ بِٱلْحَقِّ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلْخُرُوجِ
en: (42) The Day they will hear the blast [of the Horn] in truth. That is the Day of Emergence [from the graves].
tr: Yawma yasmaʿūnaṣ-ṣayḥata bil-ḥaqq, dhālika yawmul-khurūj

ar: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نُحْىِۦ وَنُمِيتُ وَإِلَيْنَا ٱلْمَصِيرُ
en: (43) Indeed, it is We who give life and cause death, and to Us is the destination
tr: Innā naḥnu nuḥyī wanumītu waʾilaynal-maṣīr

ar: يَوْمَ تَشَقَّقُ ٱلْأَرْضُ عَنْهُمْ سِرَاعًا ذَٰلِكَ حَشْرٌ عَلَيْنَا يَسِيرٌ
en: (44) On the Day the earth breaks away from them [and they emerge] rapidly; that is a gathering easy for Us.
tr: Yawma tashaqqaqul-arḍu ʿanhum sirāʿā, dhālika ḥashrun ʿalaynā yasīr

ar: نَّحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ وَمَآ أَنتَ عَلَيْهِم بِجَبَّارٍ فَذَكِّرْ بِٱلْقُرْءَانِ مَن يَخَافُ وَعِيدِ
en: (45) We are most knowing of what they say, and you are not over them a tyrant.[1533] But remind by the Qur’ān whoever fears My threat.
enNotes: [1533]- Forcing people to belief or submission.
tr: Naḥnu aʿlamu bimā yaqūlūna wamā anta ʿalayhim bijabbār, fadhakkir bil-qurʾāni may yakhāfu waʿīd
